parameters.query:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_phone, equipment_requested 
      ORDER BY client_final_rate ASC  -- best rate pehle
    ) AS rn
  FROM partners_dispatch
  WHERE 
    dispatch_status = 'Available'
    AND client_call_attempts < 2
    AND (client_call_status = 'pending' OR client_call_status IS NULL)
)
SELECT 
  customer_phone,
  customer_name,
  customer_email,
  json_agg(json_build_object(
    'dispatch_id',        dispatch_id,
    'equipment_requested', equipment_requested,
    'city',               city,
    'start_date',         start_date,
    'end_date',           end_date,
    'client_final_rate',  client_final_rate,
    'vendor_name',        vendor_name,
    'vendor_phone',       vendor_phone,
    'vendor_email',       vendor_email,
    'vendor_base_rate',   vendor_base_rate,
    'markup_amount',      markup_amount,
    'crm_vendor_id',      crm_vendor_id
  )) AS equipments
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY customer_phone, customer_name, customer_email
ORDER BY MIN(created_at) ASC;

UPDATE partners_dispatch 
SET 
  client_call_attempts  = client_call_attempts + 1,
  client_call_status    = 'calling',
  client_last_called_at = NOW(),
  updated_at            = NOW()
WHERE dispatch_id IN (
  '{{ $json.equipments.map(e => e.dispatch_id).join("','") }}'
)
RETURNING dispatch_id, client_call_attempts, client_call_status;

INSERT INTO clients (
  client_id,
  full_name,
  phone_number,
  email,
  company_name,
  address,
  city,
  state_region,
  postal_code,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  '{{ $json.body.customer_name }}',
  '{{ $json.body.customer_phone }}',
  '{{ $json.body.customer_email }}',
  '{{ $json.body.company_name }}',
  '{{ $json.body.address }}',
  '{{ $json.body.city }}',
  '{{ $json.body.state_region }}',
  '{{ $json.body.postal_code }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (phone_number) 
DO UPDATE SET
  full_name    = EXCLUDED.full_name,
  email        = EXCLUDED.email,
  company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name,
  address      = EXCLUDED.address,
  city         = EXCLUDED.city,
  state_region = EXCLUDED.state_region,
  postal_code  = EXCLUDED.postal_code
RETURNING client_id;

INSERT INTO rentals (
  rental_id,
  client_id,
  start_time,
  expected_return_time,
  total_price,
  status,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  '{{ $json.client_id }}',
  '{{ $json.start_time }}',
  '{{ $json.expected_return_time }}',
  {{ $json.client_final_rate }},
  'active',
  NOW()
)
RETURNING rental_id;

UPDATE partners_dispatch
SET
  client_id        = '{{ $json.client_id }}',
  rental_id        = '{{ $json.rental_id }}',
  client_call_status = 'accepted',
  dispatch_status  = 'Confirmed',
  updated_at       = NOW()
WHERE dispatch_id  = '{{ $json.dispatch_id }}'
RETURNING dispatch_id, client_id, rental_id, dispatch_status;

UPDATE partners_dispatch
SET
  client_call_status = 'rejected',
  dispatch_status    = 'Cancelled',
  updated_at         = NOW()
WHERE dispatch_id = ANY(
  string_to_array('{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.all_dispatch_ids }}', ',')::uuid[]
)
RETURNING dispatch_id, client_call_status, dispatch_status;

parameters.query:
UPDATE partners_dispatch
SET
  client_call_status    = CASE 
    WHEN client_call_attempts >= 2 THEN 'max_reached'
    ELSE 'pending'
  END,
  client_last_called_at = NOW(),
  updated_at            = NOW()
WHERE dispatch_id = ANY(
  string_to_array('{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.all_dispatch_ids }}', ',')::uuid[]
)
RETURNING dispatch_id, client_call_attempts, client_call_status;
